A unit is live only where at least two SA retailers show a regular price for the same product; list = lowest x 1.08. Everything else is quoted with the supplier. Bricks are sold per 1,000; units_per_m2 is the count per m² of single-leaf wall with 10 mm joints (bricks and blocks), of paved area (pavers and slabs, laid tight) or of wall face (retaining blocks, as the maker lists).
